title: Why are European banks moving gold out of United States?
summary: The Netherlands and France have moved their gold out of US vaults. Part of the reason is fears about the reliability of the US, but equally important is the need to keep gold closer to home in the event of a crisis.

title: Asia FX: Resilience at risk as US yields climb – MUFG
summary: MUFG’s Michael Wan notes that Asia FX and rates have stayed relatively stable despite sharply higher US Treasury yields, but he warns this resilience may not last in the near term.

title: Japanese Yen rises as the Greenback's inflation bounce fades
summary: USD/JPY is trading around 153.70 on Friday, down for the day after briefly spiking above 154.50 following the US inflation release.

title: At least 46,000 displaced by escalating Yemen fighting: UN
summary: The International Organisation for Migration (IOM) warns that the figure is rising by the hour .
